artworks.title: Four Naked Women
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 19.1 x 13.1 cm (7 1/2 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with fine black lines against cream-white paper, four nude, curvy women stand in a loose circle enclosed within an interior space, as a demon peeks around an opening along the left edge of this vertical engraving. The women nearly fill the composition and the room they occupy. Three of the women stand in a line in front of us so they span the foreground. The women to the left and center stand with their backs to us. The woman to our right and the woman on the far side of the circle face us. Their hair is bound up in headdresses, scarves, or veils. The woman to our right holds a swath of drapery across her hips and it cascades to the floor near a skull and long bone resting at their feet. An arched opening to the right and a squared opening to the left are both dark. An orb hangs above the group at the upper center, and it is inscribed with the letters “OGH” and the date, "1497." The demon peeking from the shadows along the left edge has a snout like a lion, and its gaping jaws reveal sharp teeth and a long tongue. It clutches a pair of thin sticks in one paw and flames flare up behind it. The contours of the women and the room are shaded with long, parallel strokes and crosshatching. A monogram with a capital D tucked between the legs of a wide, upper case A is inscribed at the bottom center of the sheet.

artworks.title: Lady on Horseback and the Lansquenet
artworks.description: Two individuals are depicted in the image. One person is standing beside a horse, while another is seated side-saddle on the horse. The man stands below the woman, who is seated above him on the horse. The man has sharp facial features and short hair, looking up at the woman. The woman has a gentle facial expression, delicate features, and her hair is tucked under a headdress with a long feather. Both individuals are dressed in historical attire. The man appears to be wearing armor or a fitted outfit with puffed sleeves, while the woman wears a long gown with puffed sleeves and a voluminous skirt. The man is holding a pole weapon with a blade, and the horse is equipped with a detailed bridle. The background shows a landscape with a body of water, a distant shore with mountains, and a castle on a hill among trees.

artworks.title: Peasant and His Wife
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of two individuals, a man and a woman, standing next to each other on a textured ground. The man is positioned with his left arm raised and his right arm pointing, appearing to be in a moment of animated conversation. He has unkempt hair, and his facial features are characterized by an open mouth and expressive eyes. He is dressed in a belted tunic with puffed sleeves and tighter-fitting pants, completed with shoes. The woman stands slightly turned towards the man, with her arms gracefully at her side, holding a decorative pitcher. She has braided hair adorned with long strands hanging down and possesses calm facial features with eyes cast downward. Her clothing is a long, flowing gown with detailed folds and wide sleeves, also featuring shoes peeking beneath the hem. The background is a simple gradient.

artworks.title: Incest of Loth
artworks.description: The image features swirling lines and serpentine shapes forming an intricate design. A central staircase-like structure rises in a pyramid shape, surrounded by ornate borders with scrolls and mythical creatures resembling dragons. At the base, two symmetrical fiery explosions flank the central structure, with small structures reminiscent of castles or buildings engulfed in flames. The composition is framed by decorative elements.

artworks.title: Death of Abel
artworks.description: The image displays intricate swirling lines and ornate patterns in a symmetrically balanced composition. In the center, there are figures resembling a satyr and another humanoid figure in an ambiguous pose, surrounded by leafy shapes and rounded arch elements. On each side, there are urns emitting flame-like swirls. Below, there are two seated figures on stone-like spheres. The design is enclosed within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Essau Selling his Birthright
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring two human figures surrounded by fantastical animals and decorative elements. The artwork includes a unicorn-like creature, griffons, swirls, and floral motifs. The scene is bordered in a classical style, resembling a Renaissance or Baroque etching. The figures are symmetrically positioned with a central lamp-like feature at the top.

artworks.title: Sacrifice of Abraham
artworks.description: The image shows a stepped platform with two human-like figures at the top, a spire emitting swirling smoke, a humanoid figure at the base, and mythical creatures below the steps. Ornamental motifs, whimsical creatures, and decorative elements fill the scene. The border includes floral vines, stylized urns, and winged creatures with coiled tails and elaborate headdresses in the corners. The art style appears to be influenced by Renaissance or Baroque styles.

artworks.title: The Deluge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring mythical creatures and elaborate decorations. The artwork includes a symmetrical composition with a central structure resembling a chariot or carriage, flanked by various mythological beings. In the scene, figures are riding on creatures with long flowing tails and other hybrid beings that combine animal and human features. The top of the image is dominated by draped curtains and flowing plumes, adorned with birds. The scene is bordered with swirling designs, enhancing the opulent and otherworldly theme. The overall tone of the image is mysterious and whimsical, blending fantasy and mythological elements.

artworks.title: The Fall of Man
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate and symmetrical decorative scene featuring mythological figures. The composition includes two seated and partially draped figures on ornate, symmetrical ornaments resembling ships on water. They are positioned on either side of a central tree with fruit, decorative garlands, and a suspended skull. The scene includes scrolls, festoons, swans, birds, and branches. There is an interplay of dynamic lines and ornate detailing influenced by classical and ornamental art designs. The borders are decorated with natural elements like foliage and waves.

artworks.title: Three Peasants in Conversation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.8 x 7.7 cm (4 1/4 x 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three men standing closely together in a circular formation. Each man faces one another as if in conversation. The man on the left wears a long-sleeved tunic with a belt and a cap with a length of fabric hanging down the back. His facial features are partially visible, with a prominent nose and upward gaze towards the man in the middle. The central figure wears a turban-like headdress, has a thick beard and mustache, and holds a long stick or staff with both hands. He is dressed in a similar long-sleeved tunic and appears slightly taller. The man on the right is facing slightly towards the middle man; he wears a wide-brimmed fur hat and a layered tunic with a belt. His face shows a prominent nose and small eyes, and he holds a woven basket in his right hand, with a small case or sheath hanging from his belt. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed linework and texture on the men's clothes and features.

artworks.title: The Virgin on the Crescent
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.8 x 7.7 cm (4 1/4 x 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman holding an infant in her arms. The woman has long hair, wears a headband, and draped clothing extending to her feet. She stands on a crescent moon surrounded by radiant lines forming a halo effect. The baby has delicate features and small tufts of hair, also enveloped in the halo effect. The woman wears a ring on one of her fingers. The background is a plain light tone, emphasizing the intricate line work.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian Bound to the Column
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.9 x 7.9 cm (4 5/16 x 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length view of a male figure standing against a stone pillar. He has an athletic build, is mostly unclothed except for a cloth around his waist, and his arms are bound behind his back. His torso and upper legs are pierced by three arrows. The man has high cheekbones, a prominent nose, slightly parted lips, and shoulder-length curly hair. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background shows a natural setting with tall grass and a rock formation to the right, appearing to be in a desolate area with sparse vegetation. Engraved markings and a signature-like inscription are near the stone pillar on the left.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian Bound to the Tree
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.6 x 7.2 cm (4 9/16 x 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man tied to a tree with his arms raised above his head and bound with rope. He has curly hair, a beard, a neutral facial expression, and a muscular body. He is pierced by several arrows in various parts of his body. He wears a cloth around his waist and there are no other visible objects on him. The background is minimalistic, with a tree trunk and a small grass patch at the base. The illustration is monochrome.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows with Arms Outstretched
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to platemark): 11.8 x 7.1 cm (4 5/8 x 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows a man standing next to a large wooden pole, with his arms bent and extended outward, his palms facing up. The man has pale skin, a thin beard, and long, wavy hair, and he his wearing a crown of thorny branches on his head. He has deep set eyes that look upward, prominent cheekbones, and an open, downturned mouth. He is bare-chested, with a simple cloth around his waist. By his feet are with a skull, a bundle of sticks, and a long strip of fabric. He has holes in his palms and on the top of his feet, and a wound in his side. The sky behind him is blank, and the print is on beige paper.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with Saint Anne
artworks.description: The image depicts two women standing facing each other with their bodies slightly angled toward the center. One woman is wearing a headscarf and the other woman has long hair. They are each holding a child, who is being cared for between them. Above them is an enthroned figure within a radiant cloud with beams extending downward. The background of the image features engraved lines and textures.

artworks.title: Standard Bearer
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.6 x 7.1 cm (4 9/16 x 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with a pole and a flag in his right hand. He has curly hair and is wearing an elaborate costume with a cape adorned with feathers. The ground is rocky with grass, and there is water in the background with sailboats and distant landmasses.

artworks.title: The Dream of the Doctor (Temptation of the Idler)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.8 x 12 cm (7 3/8 x 4 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two main figures and a cherub-like figure, captured in full length. The man on the left is sitting, wearing draped clothing that covers most of his body, and a head wrap. Beside him, a woman stands nude, save for a small piece of cloth draped across her hips. The cherub, positioned below them, is depicted with small wings and is engaged with a ball and a bow. The background is intricately detailed with architectural elements and natural elements, including dragon-like creatures in the backdrop.

artworks.title: Hercules at the Crossroad
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene in a forest setting. The image depicts several figures in dramatic interaction surrounded by lush landscape. In the foreground, a muscular figure is engaged in a tussle with a woman, both gripping a large branch or staff. Beside them, a couple of other figures are reclined amidst the vegetation. To the right, a small cherubic figure is observing the scene. In the background, there are trees, a mountainous landscape, and the architectural structure of a castle, giving a medieval ambiance. The detail in the figures and foliage suggests the artist's skill in line work and shading, typical of master engravers from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Sea Monster ("Das Meerwunder")
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.7 x 18.8 cm (9 3/4 x 7 3/8 in.)

artworks.title: Sol Iustitiae ("Sun of Righteousness")
artworks.description: This print shows a person seated on a lion. The person's body is turned towards us, their head facing the bottom right. They are holding a sword upright in their right hand and a set of scales in their left hand. The person is wearing flowing fabric that drapes over their shoulders and arms and goes down to their bent knees. They have wide round eyes, short curly hair, and slightly downturned lips. Around their eyes and forehead, is a mask-like covering shaped like a maple leaf, extending upwards and out to either side. Their head is surrounded by rays of light shooting outward and forming a halo. The lion the person sits on is standing, positioned horizontally, its head on the left and its tail on the right. It has a long, wavy mane, furrowed brows, and a partially open mouth. The background is blank beige paper.

artworks.title: Nemesis (The Great Fortune)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure standing on a sphere above a detailed landscape. The winged figure is depicted with one foot on a sphere, holding a goblet in one hand and various items in the other. The wings are detailed, showing feathers and the figure exhibits a dynamic pose with flowing fabric wrapping around them. Below the figure is a detailed landscape, featuring a winding river, trees, and a town with buildings and a church. The landscape is rendered with a high level of detail, giving a sense of depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Apollo and Diana
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.6 x 7.2 cm (4 9/16 x 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a scene. The left figure is standing up, facing right with a slight turn to the left. The person is depicted in full-body view, with muscular features, long curly hair, a laurel wreath, and holding a bow. The right figure is seated on the ground, partially visible from the waist up, with distinct facial features, long straight hair held back by a band with a jewel, and holding foliage or a plant. The seated figure has a relaxed posture. The background has a lightly textured surface, and the ground where the seated figure rests shows a lion's pelt with a visible lion's head. A monogram or artist's signature is in the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on a Grassy Bench
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated and holding a child. The woman has her head slightly tilted downwards as she looks at the child. Her face is detailed, with a veil or head covering over her hair. She is wearing a flowing garment. The child has curly hair. In the background, there is a wooden fence, sparse vegetation, and a sign on a wooden post. A stone at the bottom of the image has an inscription.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms with a Skull
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.3 x 16 cm (8 3/4 x 6 5/16 in.)
